rounds.user: Let's start a baseline model. Use churned as the target, make a stratified 80/20 train-test split with a fixed random seed, and build a preprocessing pipeline that imputes missing tenure, one-hot encodes plan, and handles the numeric features. rounds.user: That 0.97 AUC looks suspicious. Check exactly how support_tickets_90d is defined and whether its 90-day window can include tickets logged after a customer churned. Inspect the available metadata or data-generation notes before we trust either model result.
rounds.assistant: The field definition confirms that support_tickets_90d is calculated relative to the dataset snapshot and can include tickets recorded after the churn event. That leaks post-outcome information into the model, so the 0.91 logistic and 0.97 boosted AUC results using this feature should not be treated as valid performance estimates.

rounds.user: Drop support_tickets_90d completely, retrain both logistic regression and the gradient-boosted model on the same split, and report the new holdout ROC AUCs. Clearly label the earlier 0.91 and 0.97 results as invalid due to leakage.
